checks.name: No part interferes with another
checks.detail: 0 clashes across all part pairs. Press fits by design: Switch cover LIGHTS / Hinge pin (2 mm steel), Switch cover MODE / Hinge pin (2 mm steel)

checks.name: Contacts are seating faces only
checks.detail: 21 face contacts (parts resting on each other, no overlap): Rear shell / Front bezel; Rear shell / Battery door; Rear shell / Compute hatch; Rear shell / Power key cap; Rear shell / Display (Touch Display 2); Rear shell / Pi 5 + Active Cooler; Rear shell / Toggle MAIN; Rear shell / Toggle TEST; Rear shell / Boost 5 V 5 A; Rear shell / BMS + fuse; Rear shell / INA260; Rear shell / GX12-5 socket; Rear shell / USB-C charge board; Front bezel / Control panel overlay; Front bezel / Toggle LIGHTS; Front bezel / Toggle MODE; Key cap ACK / Tactile switch ACK; Key cap SNOOZE / Tactile switch SNOOZE; Power key cap / Power tactile switch; Tactile key board / Tactile switch ACK; Tactile key board / Tactile switch SNOOZE

checks.name: Printed parts are single, valid, watertight solids
checks.detail: 10 parts

checks.name: Every part fits a 250 × 210 mm bed
checks.detail: largest: Rear shell 240.0 × 138.0 × 36.0 mm

checks.name: Local wall thickness ≥ 0.8 mm (two extrusion widths)
checks.detail: 1st-percentile thickness: Rear shell 1.7, Front bezel 1.4, Control panel overlay 1.0, Battery door 1.0, Compute hatch 1.0, Key cap ACK 1.0, Key cap SNOOZE 1.1, Switch cover LIGHTS 1.1, Switch cover MODE 1.1, Power key cap 3.0

checks.name: Structural walls ≥ 2.4 mm (six perimeters)
checks.detail: wall 2.4 mm, floor 2.4 mm, bezel plate 2.4 mm

checks.name: Prints without support material
checks.detail: largest overhang patch steeper than 45°: 16.6 mm² (Switch cover LIGHTS; limit 25 mm²); widest horizontal bridge ≈ 12.9 mm (Rear shell; limit 20 mm, width estimated as 4·area/perimeter)

checks.name: Plan-view corner radius
checks.detail: 13.0 mm on all corners. NASA-STD-3001 V2 9009/9011 require rounding; confirm against Table 9.3-1/9.3-2.

checks.name: Exposed edge radius
checks.detail: 3.0 mm front and rear perimeters. Confirm against Table 9.3-1/9.3-2.

checks.name: Front pushbuttons sized for gloved use
checks.detail: 24 mm square caps, 10 mm apart, inside 2 mm collars (cap flush with collar); ACK has a raised ring and a red backlight. Target ≥ 19 mm, ≥ 10 mm apart (confirm vs NASA-STD-3001 Table 10.4-4).

checks.name: Front toggles spaced for gloved use
checks.detail: bat-handle toggles 22 mm apart, each under its own flip-up cover with 6 mm between covers; positions engraved beside each cover.

checks.name: Toggles guarded against inadvertent operation
checks.detail: LIGHTS and MODE under hinged flip-up covers (2 mm lift tab on the free edge): 4.1 mm over the lever tip, 2.7 mm beside it in either position. MAIN and TEST levers end 2.2 mm below the top edge in recessed wells; power key recessed 1.4 mm. NASA-STD-3001 V2 10027.

checks.name: Switch covers swing open without interference
checks.detail: clear at 30°, 60° and 90°; at about 114° the cover comes to rest on the panel, so it stays open past vertical

checks.name: Connector spacing and keying
checks.detail: LIGHT OUT (GX12, keyed round) on the right edge and CHG 5V (USB-C) on the bottom edge: different faces and shapes, 97 mm apart, so they cannot be swapped. Top-edge controls 22 mm apart or more. NASA-STD-3001 V2 9029/9030/9032.

checks.name: Grasping and restraint provisions
checks.detail: Tether loop (two 3 mm slots for 12 mm webbing) top-left of the rear; VESA 75 M4 inserts for a wall or arm mount; the 41.5 mm control strip is a hand grip. NASA-STD-3001 V2 9016.

checks.name: Front label height
checks.detail: 2.8 mm cap height on the front panel; 0.4° at a 400 mm hand-held viewing distance needs 2.79 mm (NASA-STD-3001 V2 10066: 12 pt or 0.4°). Rear service labels 3.0 to 3.4 mm.

checks.name: Controls and connectors labelled
checks.detail: Engraved: ACK, SNOOZE on the caps; LIGHTS and MODE on the switch covers, LINK/MAN and CREW/CTRL beside them, LIGHTS, MODE and LIGHT on the bezel; MAIN, TEST, PWR, LIGHT OUT, CHG 5V, TETHER, BATTERY, +UP, COMPUTE on the rear. NASA-STD-3001 V2 9118.

checks.name: Vent area for the Pi 5 Active Cooler
checks.detail: intake 520 mm² (compute hatch, 2 mm finger-safe slots), exhaust 528 mm² (top edge); fan inlet ≈ 450 mm² (VERIFY). Confirm with a 10-minute stress test: SoC < 80 °C.

checks.name: Bezel screws engage their inserts without bottoming out
checks.detail: M3×35 engages 5.5 mm of a 5.7 mm insert; tip stops 1.6 mm short of the front plate.

checks.name: Heat-set insert bosses ≥ insert hole + 3 mm
checks.detail: M2.5: Ø7.0 boss on Ø3.6 hole; M3: Ø7.0 on Ø4.0 (merged into the outer wall); M4: Ø10 on Ø5.6.

checks.name: Bezel holds the display glass outside the viewing area
checks.detail: 16.0 mm of bezel over the glass border on each side; 0.5 mm foam gasket.

checks.name: Hand-held mass
checks.detail: 770 g estimated (228 g printed PETG). Design target ≤ 1000 g; weigh the built unit.

checks.name: Battery energy and protection
checks.detail: 25.2 Wh (1S2P protected 18650, BMS, fuse, MAIN disconnect). Confirm cell selection and tests against JSC 20793 (crewed vehicle battery safety) before any crewed use.
